column5: src/components/Modals/WithdrawModal.tsx submits a customer chosen amount to the money-out endpoint - deductBalance at :97-101 posts amount plus description to /user/wallet/deduct-balance. The only bounds applied before that call are parsedAmount <= 0 at :55 and parsedAmount > 1000000 at :63 plus description length and charset rules. The available wallet balance is NEVER consulted - the string balance does not appear anywhere in the file - so the component would happily request a withdrawal of a million units from an account holding ten. NOT CURRENTLY REACHABLE - a search across src finds no render site for WithdrawModal so the component is dead code and there is no UI path to it today. It is recorded because the flaw ships in the repository and would become live the moment anyone mounts it - and because the same hard-coded 1000000 ceiling appears here as in the deposit modal which code review issue 33 already records as market-blind. The endpoint itself remains callable by any authenticated client independently of this component so its real protection has to be panel side.
